lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still at night, deep violet sky, hot magenta beam light, molten amber.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Justice Will Glass Them.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Justice Will Glass Them-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Justice Will Glass Them-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: bunker
images.prompt: A heavily armored concrete bunker entrance dug deep into a mountainside, guarded by anti-aircraft guns.

images.name: warship
images.prompt: A huge dark police warship hovering high in a night sky above a colony world, searchlights below.

images.name: beam
images.prompt: A bright beam of energy from the sky melting a glowing hole down into layered rock.

images.name: fortress
images.prompt: A cross-section of a fortress buried under layers of rock, concrete and steel, a command room at the bottom.

images.name: route
images.prompt: A patrol ship flying past a chain of small colony planets in a violet nebula.

images.name: coffee
images.prompt: A cup of coffee steaming beside a glowing game screen on a desk at night.

images.name: guns
images.prompt: A rotary machine gun turret on a warship's hull firing tracers into the dark.

images.name: missiles
images.prompt: Missiles streaking up out of a crater in the ground toward the sky, smoke trails behind them.

images.name: clues
images.prompt: Thick cables and ventilation shafts running down through exposed rock toward something hidden below.

images.name: core
images.prompt: A gigantic explosion erupting from deep underground, a mountain lifting apart in fire.
